source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Rheumatoid arthritis, an inflammatory autoimmune arthritis usually associated with objective joint inflammation and stiffness.","B":"Normal aging, in which persistent widespread pain, fatigue, sleep disturbance, and cognitive impairment are expected findings.","C":"An acute bacterial infection, which would more typically produce an acute systemic illness rather than months of stable symptoms.","D":"Fibromyalgia, a chronic pain disorder commonly associated with widespread pain, fatigue, sleep disturbance, and cognitive symptoms."}}
source_row.rationale: Fibromyalgia is a chronic disorder characterized by widespread pain and commonly includes fatigue, sleep disturbance and cognitive symptoms. There is no single laboratory or imaging test that confirms the diagnosis; evaluation may exclude other causes.

source_row.stem: A client reports months of widespread pain, fatigue, poor sleep, and difficulty concentrating. No alternative inflammatory or structural diagnosis has been identified. Which condition is most consistent with this presentation?
